$schema-note: EngiRent single source of truth for design tokens (E3.1). Every value here was DERIVED from the four surfaces' existing theme files on 2026-09-08, not invented — Flutter (constants/app_colors.dart, core/theme/*), admin (app/theme.ts), kiosk (theme.css), website. Generators emit per-surface artifacts FROM this file so the four can no longer drift by hand. References like {palette.teal.500} resolve to the raw ramp value.

palette.$note: Raw, theme-agnostic ramps. 500 is the on-light anchor; higher = darker, lower = lighter. These match Flutter AppColors and admin's Mantine tuples to the hex today.

review.$note: The PENDING / under-review family. Seeded from Flutter's existing info #0E9BB8, a cyan-teal DISTINCT from brand blue. This is the one color promoted cross-surface by E3.1 to satisfy 'PENDING is never red or warning-yellow' — a DECISION worth confirming with the human.

ink.$note: Neutral ramp, TEAL-TINTED on purpose — the mandate bans the generic #6B7280 gray family. Flutter still uses banned greys (#9CA3AF/#4B5563/#D1D5DB); E3.1 replaces them with these.

semantic.$note: Role tokens, resolved per theme. Screens consume these, never a raw ramp value.

status.$note: Domain status -> semantic role. ONE meaning across all four surfaces. NOTE: today both Flutter and admin map PENDING to warning (yellow); this table moves it to 'review', which is the E3.1 change, applied when generators run.

space.$grid: 8px, with a single 4px sub-step for icon-label gaps only

elevation.$note: borders do the work shadows used to — one hairline shadow, no ladder

kiosk.$note: The kiosk renders the DARK resolution only (theme.css --bg #050f1a). It is not light-only. Physical corridor-lighting contrast check is B-2-blocked while the Pi is offline.
